changelog.summary: Adds a chat-led Support feedback to Product decision route with source coverage, duplicate and issue-action contracts.

title: Feedback Theme to Product Decision
description: Validate a bounded customer feedback theme, compare it with current product work, and prepare an owner-reviewed decision without silently creating roadmap work.
setup_prompt: Use Feedback Theme to Product Decision as a chat-led proposal. Inspect existing Feedback & Review Analyst and Product Feedback Coordinator Crews, feedback source permissions, bounded product and segment scope, current issue/roadmap source, privacy rule and product owner. Propose reuse or reviewed creation, exact validated artifacts, one manual theme and separate action approvals. Show the concrete plan before Builder applies it. Selecting this Playbook creates no issue, roadmap commitment, customer message or recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Tenant, product, segment, channels, period and allowed feedback sources
Current issue, roadmap and product evidence source or export
Product owner, issue-match and prioritization policy
Privacy, quotation and exact issue/customer action authority
Manual-only or reviewed feedback event and cadence

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew
recommended_tools.purpose: Create reviewed missing Support or Product Crew with stable keys

recommended_tools.name: Builder manage_crew_attachment
recommended_tools.purpose: Pass a validated bounded theme with privacy scope to Product

recommended_tools.name: Helpdesk, survey or review export
recommended_tools.purpose: Read exact feedback records and denominator coverage

recommended_tools.name: Issue tracker, roadmap or product export
recommended_tools.purpose: Verify existing issue, status and owner decisions

recommended_tools.name: Approved issue-tracker route
recommended_tools.purpose: Apply only a separately approved exact issue change and retain receipt

pulse_focus.label: Feedback to product decision
focus_areas: Whether theme prevalence and affected segment match source coverage
Whether Product decisions and issue outcomes remain traceable without duplicate work or customer promises
review_when: A new comparable feedback window arrives, an existing issue changes, or an owner decision becomes due

outputs: Reviewed Support and Product Crew roster with source and privacy map
Validated product-feedback-decision/v1 with current issue observation
Manual theme, owner decision, action ledger and activation choice
